name: van-code
description: Jean-Claude Van Code: production discipline for Claude Code. Proof before done, no silenced failures, nothing that passes locally and breaks the deploy

profile.title: Profile
profile.description: full: every switch below as set. light: no Haiku calls or end-of-turn reviews (Chong Li, intent diff, reply suggestions, archaeology, clean-room, card plan). minimal: only the safety rails and read savings. /van-code profile changes it for one session.

intro.title: Intro animation
intro.description: The flying kick into Clawd when Claude starts. Off: the factory checklist shows only when something is missing.

guard.title: Heavy-file guard
guard.description: Blocks whole reads of lockfiles, node_modules, build output and minified files. /van-code:guard toggles it for the session.

readMemory.title: Read memory
readMemory.description: Refuses to re-read a file that has not changed since the last read.

postEditCheck.title: Post-edit check
postEditCheck.description: Runs tsc, ruff, go vet or bash -n on the edited file and hands the errors back to Claude.

proveIt.title: Prove it works
proveIt.description: Asks Claude to verify when it edits code and runs no test or build.

outlineFirst.title: Outline first
outlineFirst.description: A whole Read of a code file over 400 lines is refused once with the file's outline (declarations and their line ranges), so Claude reads only the part it needs. Reading again goes through.

antiCheat.title: Anti-cheat
antiCheat.description: After a failing check or test in a turn, flags an edit that silences it instead of fixing it: as any, @ts-ignore, lint or type-check suppressions, skipped tests, || true, removed assertions.

intentDiff.title: Intent diff
intentDiff.description: Flags a dependency the request never named, on the edit or install that added it, and after a big turn asks Haiku what the changes did that was not asked, or left out.

archaeology.title: Archaeology
archaeology.description: When an edit removes lines that git blame traces to a commit reading as a fix (fix, race, workaround, #123), Claude is shown that commit and asked to check the bug does not come back.

cleanRoom.title: Clean-room check
cleanRoom.description: At the end of a turn, flags what the new code leaves that works here and breaks elsewhere: debug leftovers, localhost URLs, env vars missing from .env.example, relative imports that match only ignoring case, packages not declared in package.json.

migrationGate.title: Migration gate
migrationGate.description: Flags migration statements that lock a big table or break the code still running during a deploy (DROP/RENAME COLUMN, type changes, NOT NULL without a default, indexes without CONCURRENTLY, unvalidated constraints), in SQL, Alembic, Rails and Knex migrations.

schemaGuard.title: Schema guard
schemaGuard.description: Compares an edited .proto or .avsc file with its last commit and flags breaking changes: removed fields without reserved tags, type changes, reused tags, Avro fields added or removed without a default.

chongLi.title: Automatic Chong Li
chongLi.description: A cheap adversarial review (Haiku) of big or risky changes. /van-code:chong-li always works.

suggestions.title: Reply suggestions
suggestions.description: Proposes your next message (Tab) when Claude Code proposes none. Uses Haiku.

rules.title: Van Code rules
rules.description: Extra instructions for Claude: verify before claiming, read only what is needed, be direct, test before saying done.

infraGuard.title: Infra guard
infraGuard.description: Holds terraform/tofu apply, kubectl and helm changes until a plan, diff or dry run ran, and refuses deletes (kubectl, helm, aws, gcloud, az, pulumi) once. Running the command again goes through.

gitGuard.title: Git guard
gitGuard.description: Refuses once git commands that throw away uncommitted work (reset --hard, checkout --, restore, clean -f, stash drop) when the tree is dirty, and force pushes, listing what would be lost. Running the command again goes through.

receipts.title: Receipts
receipts.description: Checks Claude's final answer against the tool output: a test count that differs from the turn's last test run, or a commit hash no tool showed, is flagged and Claude corrects it on your next message.

adhd.title: ADHD mode
adhd.description: The bundled i-have-adhd skill on in every session: next action first, numbered steps, state restated each turn, no tangents. "stop adhd mode" ends it for the session.

noAttribution.title: No AI attribution
noAttribution.description: Claude never credits itself or any AI in commits, PRs, comments or docs; a git commit or gh pr/issue carrying an AI Co-Authored-By or "Generated with" line is refused until the line is removed.

compactRestore.title: Compaction restore
compactRestore.description: Tells the summarizer to keep constraints and decisions, then hands Claude your own messages (verbatim) and the assumption ledger right after a compaction.

compactTrim.title: Compaction trim
compactTrim.description: Before a compaction, cuts old tool output over 2,000 characters to its first 600, so the summary is cheaper and about decisions, not dumps. The newest 12 messages and errors stay whole.

cardPlan.title: Card plan
cardPlan.description: When a message reads as a pasted user story, bug report or task card, Claude is told to list its acceptance criteria as targets, ask only what is ambiguous, and reproduce a bug before fixing it.

usageHeader.title: Usage header
usageHeader.description: Model, rate-limit bars (5h, 7d) with time until reset, and context, above the prompt.
